items.title: From legacy to AI-powered: Transform your customer experience with Amazon Connect Customer Competency Partners
items.summary: The Amazon Connect Customer Competency now recognizes Software Partners alongside Services Partners, with three new categories that help customers find validated Partners who can migrate legacy contact centers, build AI-powered customer experiences, and extend Amazon Connect Customer with specialized software. Benefits include additional Marketing Development Funds, AWS Migration Acceleration Program funding, and dedicated co-selling support.
items.creator: Lawrence Tse
